messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — performance review cycle timeline and calibration slots.
maya: Managers: please submit self + manager reviews by Mon Apr 24 23:59 PT. Use the new review form: https://redwood.company/sr-review-v2
maya: We're scheduling calibration sessions Mon Apr 29–Wed May 1. Aim for 30–60m blocks per org.
maya: Action items: 1) schedule calibration with your cohort; 2) upload final ratings spreadsheet to Drive; 3) notify ICs about outcomes.
samir: Thanks — where's the new form? can we see the rating rubric?
maya: Form link above. Rubric is in the same folder (Calibration Rubric 2026.pdf) — please read before calibrations.
zoe: FYI we've standardized the rating scale to 1–5 with concrete examples per level. Read the cheat sheet before you meet.
eli: Can we get a designated calibrator? last cycle spread was inconsistent across managers.
maya: Yes — people-ops will assign one floating calibrator per cohort and one facilitator. @people-ops-bot will post invites.
people-ops-bot: calendar: Calibration invite templates added to the shared calendar. Copy into your team calendar or request auto-invite (people-ops will send on Apr 25).
nina: Heads-up for APAC teams — Apr 24 is a public holiday for some locales. Can we get a short extension for those teams?
zoe: Please file an extension request in the form (link) with approver CC. We'll approve case-by-case; standard extension deadline is Mon Apr 26 23:59 PT.
samir: Quick Q: are peer feedbacks required or optional?
maya: Peer feedback is optional but strongly recommended. For anonymized collection use the 'peer-anon' collection; close by EOD Apr 20 to include in manager packets.
eli: Do managers need to paste goal examples into the form or attach goal docs?
maya: Attach goal snapshots as PDF and paste a 2–3 sentence summary in the form.
nina: I'll draft the calendar invites + share the calibration slide deck and facilitation notes by EOD tomorrow.
zoe: Resources: calibration slides + facilitator cheat sheet -> https://redwood.company/calibration-kit. Use the template to capture decision rationale.
maya: Thanks all. If you need an exception or help with the spreadsheet reach out to me or @zoe. :thumbsup:
